caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular section of fabric featuring an intricate pattern of flowers and leaves. The primary colors used are red and light green, set against a beige or pale tan background. The floral motifs vary in size and complexity, with multiple large blossoms, leafy branches, and curling petals distributed evenly throughout the composition. The red floral elements are prominent and have detailed linework, while the green shades are more subdued and serve as highlights within the leaves. The fabric sample appears to be quilted, with diagonal lines creating a diamond-shaped grid across the surface. The overall arrangement is dense, with minimal empty space, and the pattern extends beyond the edges of the rectangle, suggesting it is a segment of a larger textile design.
title: Infant's Quilt (Detail)
